newsitem.title: USA: Lund sees strong truck accessory demand.
newsitem.headline: Lund sees strong truck accessory demand.

text.p: Lund International Inc, which as expected reported lower earnings for the third quarter, said Wednesday that demand for truck accessories remains strong.
Earlier, Lund reported earnings for the third quarter ended March 31 of $0.11 a share, down from $0.28 a year ago.

"Although results for this quarter are disappointing, we remain optimistic about the future of Lund," William McMahon, president, said in a statement. "It appears that our industry and the demand for truck accessories in particular is strong."
Lund makes appearance accessories for trucks, sport utility vehicles and vans.
Lund said it expects a positive impact from the release of its Hatchback and Elite tonneau cover lines during the fiscal fourth quarter.
"We will have refined development, completed testing, and should begin shipping our Solar and Lunar visor line during the first quarter of fiscal 1998," McMahon added.
As previously reported, Lund's third quarter sales did not reflect the historical increases usually achieved over the first and second quarter, McMahon said.

"The lower sales levels were primarily attributable to delays in getting our new product lines to market," he added. "The delay in time to market for these new product lines, which we believe offer tremendous growth potential, have substantially impacted top line sales."
Third quarter earnings were also hurt by higher selling and marketing expenses, part of which was attributable to entering the retail automotive chain store market segment. ((Reuters
